Maya Chen: Heads-up: social plan for next week's webinar. Need X + LinkedIn scheduling. 3-post cadence + one X thread. Two creative variants: GIF hero & static. Target timings: Wed 9am PT (teaser), Thu 11am PT (main), Fri 9am PT (reminder). Copy + assets by Mon EOD.
Luca Ramirez: Do we have landing page variants + UTMs? Want A/B: benchmark CTA vs product CTA.
Samir Patel: I'll draft 3 copy options today: benchmark (cost/latency), product-first, customer-story.
Nicole O'Neil: X thread should be 4 tweets: stat opener, quick explainer, demo GIF, CTA with webinar link. Put expanded links & speaker bios in first comment. Add utm_campaign=social_webinar and source param.
Ava (Design): Can deliver 2 GIFs (1080x1080) + 2 statics (1200x628) by Mon 3pm PT. Motion? KV cache pulse or UI pan?
Maya Chen: KV cache pulse — aligns with performance message. Also include alt-text.
Luca Ramirez: UTMs: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=social_webinar&utm_content={variant}&org=redwood. LinkedIn use source=linkedin.
Samir Patel: Draft copies: "Webinar: Cut inference cost 2x w/o latency tradeoffs." "How top ML teams get predictable latency at scale." "Customer Y cut token costs 43%  walkthrough." Tone: authoritative for main, casual teaser.
Nicole O'Neil: For LinkedIn carousel lead with benchmark stat then quick steps. Also prep engagement follow-up 24h after main post — organic comment with Q&A prompt, tag two responders.
Ava (Design): Uploading mocks to /shared/marketing/assets/webinar_0412/. Will include 280-char alt-text. Can crop GIF to 30s vertical for Stories. Need safe zone guidance.
social-bot: Reminder: final assets & copy due Mon 5pm PT or scheduler slips.
Samir Patel: Numbers for benchmark slide: baseline (no cache): 280ms / $0.12/token; optimized (cache + batching): 110ms / $0.05/token. I'll add short captions. Also will draft the X first comment with links + speaker bios (with UTMs).
Luca Ramirez: Ensure registration link includes GDPR opt-out for EU. Legal cleared copy but double-check.
Maya Chen: Timeline recap: design mocks Mon 3pm PT, final copy+assets Mon 5pm PT, scheduling Wed-Thu-Fri. I'll queue once confirmed.
